primary_failure_mode_caught: Discovery lists what gets built but not what runs: which services exist, how they connect, and which health, restart, logging and monitoring controls the repository declares for them.

assumptions.posture: Read manifests, runbooks and monitoring configuration as statements of intent; a configured probe or alert says nothing about whether it fires.

required_inputs: the accepted devops project inventory and partition map
service and deployment manifests, health and smoke tests, monitoring configuration and runbooks in the target repository
outputs: a declared service inventory (service-inventory.json) and its summary
must_not: take a compose file for the production topology unless the repository says so
overlook missing runbooks or ownership and escalation data
